meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget wedding sarees** ke liye aapko *Meesho, Myntra, Libas, Sudathi, Mohey (Manyavar), aur Amrut Fashion* jaisi sites dekhni chahiye, kyunki in par affordable options milte hain aur price range kaafi wide hai.[1][8][12][13][18]

Aapke budget ke hisaab se practical options:

- **₹500 se kam**: Meesho aur Myntra par budget sarees mil rahi hain, jaise Georgette, Silk, Linen aur Pattu styles under 500/1000 categories mein.[15][18]
- **₹1,500–₹3,000**: Mohey/Manyavar par ₹1,499 se sarees milti hain, aur kuch elegant chiffon/organza options ₹2,999 ke around hain.[12]
- **₹2,499 ke aas-paas**: Amrut Fashion par wedding saree sale price ₹2,499 tak dikh raha hai.[13]
- **₹3,000–₹8,000**: Mohey/Manyavar ke organza, stone work, aur banarasi-type sarees is range mein aati hain.[12]
- **₹10,000+**: Agar thoda premium lena ho to Nalli, Kankatala, KanchiVML, aur Kalki Fashion par silk/kanchipuram/banarasi wedding sarees milti hain, lekin ye budget segment se upar hain.[5][6][9][11]

*Budget mein shaadi ke liye best fabric choices*:
- **Georgette**: lightweight, easy to drape, party/wedding guest ke liye achchi.[15][18]
- **Organza**: elegant look deti hai, especially reception ya sangeet ke liye.[12]
- **Banarasi look**: traditional wedding vibe ke liye, mid-budget mein bhi mil sakti hai.[12][14]
- **Silk / Pattu**: bridal feel ke liye best, but genuine silk mein price usually higher hoti hai.[5][6][15]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 5 best saree options shortlist kar du — jaise **₹1,000**, **₹3,000**, ya **₹5,000** ke under.
